posts.t: Logan Thompson (lower body) now on injured reserve for the Capitals, but will be eligible to be actived for their next game against Philadelphia on Wednesday (if ready) because last played on Tuesday.

Per colleague Harvey Valentine, Capitals goalie Logan Thompson (lower body) went on the ice and faced some shots at the start of the morning skate today. He remains day to day, but coach Spencer Carbery called it, "a positive step for him taking some shots this morning."

Capitals announce they have recalled goaltender Mitch Gibson from Hershey and have placed defenseman Vincent Desharnais on Injured Reserve (IR).

Coach Spencer Carbery said earlier today that Logan Thompson (lower body) remains day to day

Catching up, Caps coach Spencer Carbery said Logan Thompson (lower body) remains day-to-day and they'll see how he feels tomorrow. Pierre-Luc Dubois and Justin Sourdif went through full practice and Carbery will talk to trainer Jason Serbus to determine their availabity vs. Buffalo on Saturday.
No Logan Thompson (lower body) at Capitals practice again today. Pierre-Luc Dubois (illness) and Justin Sourdif (illness) are both practicing in regular jerseys.

Logan Thompson won't practice with the Capitals today. Team says he is day to day/lower body.

He was slow to get up after making consecutive saves on Artemi Panarin in the second period last night, but played the full game.
